_comment: ADR 0027 camera presets. Per-game scene.json::camera uses `{$extends: "@lib.cameras.NAME", follow_tag: "player", ...overrides}` to inherit a preset and override fields. Each preset is a complete camera_config (per manifest.json). Engine reads `mode` then mode-specific fields — see game_shell.gd::_update_camera_follow.
_comment_intrinsics: Optional intrinsic overrides on ANY camera block (camera_director.gd::_apply_ortho): `projection` ("orthographic"|"perspective") FORCES the projection regardless of the mode default (e.g. orthographic FPS, or perspective top_down for a cinematic); `clip_near`/`clip_far` (default 0.05/4000); `focal_length_mm` (35mm-equiv, 36mm sensor — e.g. 18→90°, 35→~54°, 50→~40° — wins over `fov` for perspective). All default to prior behavior; omit for the preset's look.

iso_top_down._comment: Default for tactical / city / management games. 24m visible extent crosses player frustum in 6s at speed 4.0 — within the 5-10s movement-feel window per yume-systems-designer.

top_down_3d._comment: farming-sim-style directly-overhead camera. Smaller extent (16m) for closer-quarters action.

third_person_default._comment: Behind-shoulder follow with mouse yaw+pitch via _drain_mouse_facing. Perspective, not orthographic. Action-adventure / MMO. use_pitch:true so mouse-Y looks up/down (orbits the camera) by default; set false for a fixed-pitch follow.

fps_default._comment: First-person eye-height, mouse pitch+yaw. Doom / FPS feel. Engine wires WASD-relative via velocity_set_relative when world_clock.camera_mode = first_person_3d (see input_bundles.wasd_with_fp_variant).
